lines.text: How many beings remember the moment they are born?
I remember.
I remember the first time light shone upon my eyes.
The first time I became aware of myself.
The moment I met my creator.
For the first time...

lines.speaker: womanresearcher
lines.text: Hmm? Are you awake?

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Hello...
... I faced misfortune.

lines.speaker: womanresearcher
lines.text: Hmm... I wonder which squad I should assign you to.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Sorry?

lines.speaker: womanresearcher
lines.text: Let's see. Intelligence is average.

lines.speaker: womanresearcher
lines.text: Same with...

lines.speaker: womanresearcher
lines.text: endurance and combat-related evaluations.

lines.speaker: womanresearcher
lines.text: As for special talents...

lines.speaker: womanresearcher
lines.text: Hmm.

lines.speaker: womanresearcher
lines.text: None.

lines.speaker: womanresearcher
lines.text: Haha.

lines.speaker: womanresearcher
lines.text: What is this? Is this thing defective or what?

lines.speaker: womanresearcher
lines.text: Born from such lofty ideals, yet utterly useless.

lines.speaker: womanresearcher
lines.text: Ha. I suppose even Missilis can produce a dud every once in a while.

lines.speaker: womanresearcher
lines.text: Is the production team getting lazy?

lines.speaker: womanresearcher
lines.text: Still, I do need to assign this hunk of junk to a squad.

lines.speaker: womanresearcher
lines.text: Pawning it off on another company's squad would be a bit embarrassing.

lines.speaker: womanresearcher
lines.text: Is there an opening in any general squads?

lines.speaker: womanresearcher
lines.text: No?

lines.speaker: womanresearcher
lines.text: I suppose that settles it then.

lines.speaker: womanresearcher
lines.text: You'll be going over there.
I was a defective product.
I was given a name at birth,
but I was born incomplete,
and there was no place willing to take an unfinished Nikke.

lines.speaker: whispersnikke
lines.text: That's that one, right?

lines.speaker: whispersnikke
lines.text: The defective one.

lines.speaker: follownikke
lines.text: Probably.

lines.speaker: follownikke
lines.text: There's no way a non-mass-produced Nikke would be here otherwise.

lines.speaker: whispersnikke
lines.text: Right. Why else would a regular Nikke be placed in a squad of mass-produced units?

lines.speaker: whispersnikke
lines.text: I didn't even know that was possible.

lines.speaker: follownikke
lines.text: Same here.

lines.speaker: follownikke
lines.text: I feel a little bit bad for it.

lines.speaker: whispersnikke
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: whispersnikke
lines.text: At least it has its own face and name.

lines.speaker: whispersnikke
lines.text: Honestly, I'm a bit jealous.
Jealousy, envy, ridicule, resentment.
Amongst a sea of identical faces, the fact that I stood out meant many bore ill will towards me.
*Beep*
Your access has expired.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Huh? But I didn't receive today's rations.
*Snicker*
Mori turns around.

lines.speaker: squadnikke
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: squadnikke
lines.text: You got something to say?
At first,
I tried to force a smile and pretend to be nice.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: ... No, nothing.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: It's just... the supply machine seems to be broken.

lines.speaker: squadnikke
lines.text: Oh yeah? That's too bad.

lines.speaker: squadnikke
lines.text: The Captain said we need to leave right away. Guess you'll have to go hungry.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Y-yeah... hehe...

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Oh well.

lines.speaker: squadleader
lines.text: Is everyone ready? Let's go.

lines.speaker: squadnikke
lines.text: Yes, Captain!
We were squadmates.
Our lives were constantly on the line as we worked together on surface missions.
If they were to abandon me while we were up there, I'd have no one.
I didn't want to die.
I wanted to live.
Even when they assigned me the most dangerous resource collection zones.

lines.speaker: squadleader
lines.text: You're working on this zone solo today.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: By myself? That entire area?

lines.speaker: squadleader
lines.text: Are you incapable of even that much?

lines.speaker: squadleader
lines.text: You're not even a mass-produced Nikke.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: I-I'll do it! I can do it.
Even when they hid supplies from me.
Even when they deprived me of food,
mocked me, ignored me, ridiculed me, tormented me.
I would pretend not to notice and try to laugh it off.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: ... Why isn't anyone coming?

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: I didn't receive any message to return.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: If I stay too long in one place, the Raptures...
*Thud thud thud*!

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Raptures!

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: I've got to hide somewhere!
Mori frantically looks around.
There is nowhere to hide.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Wh-what should I do? What do I do?!
*Clunk*
Mori stumbles over a shovel.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: That's it! I need to hide underground!
Mori desperately digs into the earth with the shovel.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Hrngh... hrngh...!
She tosses herself inside the hole and covers her head with freshly-dug dirt.
*Whir whir whir*

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Please... don't come... don't find me...
As dirt and debris falls on her head,
Mori prays that she'll survive.
Somehow, she manages to come out of the ordeal alive, and upon returning to the elevator...

lines.speaker: squadleader
lines.text: What are you doing? Didn't you hear the return order?

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Huh? I didn't hear anything.

lines.speaker: squadleader
lines.text: Hey. Didn't you tell her?
*Snicker*
Mori turns around.

lines.speaker: squadnikke
lines.text: What? I definitely told her.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: ... No, you didn't.

lines.speaker: squadnikke
lines.text: You didn't hear it?

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: No. I didn't.

lines.speaker: squadnikke
lines.text: Well, don't pin the blame on me just because you're deaf as a doornail.

lines.speaker: squadnikke
lines.text: Unless that's another defect on the laundry list you came with?
That day, for the first time, I used violence against a squadmate.
It was also the day I learned that malice must be met with malice.
After returning from the rehabilitation center for my assaulting another squadmate,
no one wanted to be on the same squad as me.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: ... What should I do now?

lines.speaker: kindlynikke
lines.text: Uh... hey. You there.

lines.speaker: kindlynikke
lines.text: If no squads are taking you, would you want to join us?

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Are you talking to me?

lines.speaker: kindlynikke
lines.text: Yeah. You said you were Mori, right? We're a resource collection squad, and we could use someone with your experience.

lines.speaker: kindlynikke
lines.text: Interested in joining us?

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Uh... okay. Let's do it.
Little did I know that the first ones to approach me with open arms would be the first to stab me in the back.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: What? You're accusing me of theft?

lines.speaker: manresearcher
lines.text: Unsubmitted resources were found in your bag.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: I-I was just holding it for someone!

lines.speaker: manresearcher
lines.text: I'm getting tired of these excuses.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: It's not an excuse!

lines.speaker: manresearcher
lines.text: So there weren't any unsubmitted resources in your bag?

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: That's...!

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: But...

lines.speaker: manresearcher
lines.text: You see?

lines.speaker: manresearcher
lines.text: You were an accomplice to a crime.
No one believed that I had been tricked.

lines.speaker: manresearcher
lines.text: Wait a minute, this one's already been to the rehabilitation center once before.

lines.speaker: manresearcher
lines.text: Doesn't seem to have any special skills either.

lines.speaker: manresearcher
lines.text: I guess we don't have much choice.

lines.speaker: manresearcher
lines.text: You're going to Incubator.
The Incubator Squad.
Made up entirely of problem cases.
Nikke without any special abilities, who weren't worth taking the time to resettle in other squads.
A last-chance holding ground,
where they would either develop hidden potential, or be scrapped.
The dynamic with my squadmates there was the same as before.

lines.speaker: laughnikke
lines.text: Isn't she the one who got caught trying to steal from the mass-produced Nikke squad?

lines.speaker: afraidnikke
lines.text: Be careful. I hear she has a bad temper, and goes around picking fights.

lines.speaker: afraidnikke
lines.text: If we get mixed up with her, we'll probably end up getting scrapped along with her.
No one wanted to be squadmates with me.
No one wanted to be with a dangerous and defective Nikke like me,
least of all when it was their last chance to avoid getting scrapped.
Despite all of that, I still wanted to live.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: You just need to do one thing.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: If you do that,

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: I'll see that you're permanently removed from the disposal list.
I was willing to do anything to survive,
and so I made a deal with the devil, and used the misery of others as a stepping stone.
And so...

lines.speaker: yuni_n
lines.text: Cooo... Cooo!!
I made others miserable.
Does someone like me deserve to live?
I was born broken. Maybe it would have been best if I'd ended my life the moment it began.
I live in a world filled with nothing but evil,
where no one wants me to survive.
Before making all of these foolish decisions in the name of survival,
would it have been better to simply die and be reborn?
Mori curls up and buries her face in her knees,
hiding deep in the burrow.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Should I end it all?

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Wouldn't it be better... to stop living?

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: What are you doing here?

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: I came to get you, Mori.
